meta.name: higgsfield-marketplace-cards
meta.description:
Generate marketplace product image cards through Higgsfield: compliant
main image, secondary product images, and A+ style content modules. Use when
the user asks for marketplace listing images, product detail cards,
secondary product images, product infographics, lifestyle listing shots,
A+ style content, marketplace image sets, or sales-ready product visuals.
Backend owns marketplace compliance references and prompt templates; this skill
only routes user intent to the CLI.
NOT for generic brand product photography without marketplace/listing context
(use higgsfield-product-photoshoot), video generation or UGC ads (use
higgsfield-generate), or Soul Character training (use higgsfield-soul-id).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成电商平台商品详情图与信息卡
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果:在电商平台卖货,需要合规的商品展示图
copy.tagline_en: Generate compliant product cards for your marketplace listings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you sell on marketplaces and need compliant product images

howto.what: 装好后,当你要求生成电商商品图卡时,Claude 会使用 Higgsfield 工具生成符合平台规范的主图、副图或 A+ 模块,并只返回带标签的图片链接。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成电商平台主图、副图、信息图等商品图片时触发。

say.text: 用这张产品图生成一张电商主图
帮我做一套完整的商品详情页图片
say.note: 会输出 1 张主图和 5 张副图。

say.text: 用这张精华液图片生成全套 A+ 内容
say.note: 会输出主图和 7 个 A+ 模块。

howto.what_en: When asked for marketplace product image cards, Claude uses Higgsfield to generate compliant main images, secondary images, or A+ content modules, then returns labeled image URLs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for listing images, secondary images, infographics, or similar marketplace product visuals.

say_en.text: Create a marketplace main image from this product photo.
Generate a full detail-page image set for this product.
say_en.note: Creates a main image plus 5 secondary images.

say_en.text: Build the full A+ content set for this serum image.
say_en.note: Produces main image plus 7 A+ modules.
